name: Quote card
description: A pull-quote set large on the brand's paper, one phrase in the brand colour, with who said it. Ported from the automatos-social quote family.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. WHY IT MATTERS. Leave empty for none.

quote.label: Quote
quote.description: The words, without quotation marks: the card adds them. Use | to break the line.

quote_accent.label: Accent words
quote_accent.description: Words of the quote shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

attribution.label: Attribution
attribution.description: Who said it, and where or when, e.g. LangChain, 2026.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 02 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Save this post. Leave empty for none.

sample_data.quote: The model is now a commodity. The harness is the moat.
